usage.callShape: POST https://stablesocial.dev/api/facebook/posts with JSON body {profile_id, max_posts?, order_by?, max_page_size?, cursor?} (x402-paid). Returns 202 async job. Then GET the returned pollUrl with SIWX auth from the SAME wallet that paid until status==="finished".
usage.outputShape: POST -> body.jobId, body.pollUrl, body.token, body.status (pending). Poll (GET pollUrl, SIWX) -> body.status (pending|finished), final posts at body.data.items[].
quirks: POST returns HTTP 202 with an async job (jobId+pollUrl+token, status=pending) — the posts are NOT in the POST response.
The pollUrl REQUIRES SIWX wallet auth from the SAME wallet that paid for the job; a plain unauthenticated GET returns 402 'SIWX authentication required'.
Poll with SIWX (e.g. qa-pay --siwx GET pollUrl) — polling is free (no extra charge). Loop until body.status==='finished'.
Result data lives at body.data.items[] on the finished poll response, not in the POST body.
Only profile_id is required; max_posts caps at 300 (use a small value like 1 to keep responses light).
usage.guide: POST to https://stablesocial.dev/api/facebook/posts with JSON {"profile_id":"<fb username or id>","max_posts":N}; this is x402-paid (~$0.06) and returns a 202 async job containing jobId, pollUrl, token, status:pending. Then GET the returned pollUrl using SIWX authentication signed by the SAME wallet that paid (an unauthenticated poll fails with 'SIWX authentication required'); polling is free. Repeat the poll until body.status === "finished", then read the Facebook posts from body.data.items[] (each item has id, text, owner_username/owner_full_name, timestamp, shares_count, comments_count, media URLs).
